description.value: Sunstone is one of three modernized A-frame cottages at Nectar Yoga Retreat, a wellness retreat set on 20 acres of forested land on Bowen Island—a 20-minute BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. Warm pine-clad interiors and a nature-immersive setting distinguish the retreat, and every stay includes daily breakfast, yoga, and meditation. Bowen Island itself offers mountain biking and hiking, making this a tranquil base for cyclists exploring the island.
